title: 13 July 2014: Ringo Starr live at City National Civic, San Jose, California
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the City National Civic in San Jose, California, USA, on 13 July 2014.

It was the 26th show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s tour of North America, which lasted for 46 dates between June and October 2014.

Starr returned to the City National Civic on 28 September 2018, 17 June 2023, and 11 June 2026.

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, percussion, keyboards, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums
